preamble.title: biglup/cardano_account_custody_contract
preamble.description: Cardano account custody contract: a stable per-user address with owner keys and on-chain bounded, revocable agent grants.

cardano/address/Address.title: Address
cardano/address/Address.description:
A Cardano `Address` typically holding one or two credential references.

 Note that legacy bootstrap addresses (a.k.a. 'Byron addresses') are
 completely excluded from Plutus contexts. Thus, from an on-chain
 perspective only exists addresses of type 00, 01, ..., 07 as detailed
 in [CIP-0019 :: Shelley Addresses](https://github.com/cardano-foundation/CIPs/tree/master/CIP-0019/#shelley-addresses).

cardano/address/Credential.title: Credential
cardano/address/Credential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/address/PaymentCredential.title: PaymentCredential
cardano/address/PaymentCredential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/address/StakeCredential.title: StakeCredential
cardano/address/StakeCredential.description:
Represent a type of object that can be represented either inline (by hash)
 or via a reference (i.e. a pointer to an on-chain location).

 This is mainly use for capturing pointers to a stake credential
 registration certificate in the case of so-called pointer addresses.

cardano_account_custody_contract/types/A.title: AccountRedeemer
cardano_account_custody_contract/types/A.description:
The redeemer for the account validator's spend handler.

 `Device` is the owner path: any device key may rewrite the state freely,
 as long as the result stays well formed. `SpendWithGrant` is the agent
 path: the named grant's remaining caps bound what the transaction may
 take. `Fund` is for a plain deposit UTxO at the account address, which
 only requires that the account's own state NFT is spent alongside it.

fields.title: signature
fields.description:
The 64 byte r||s secp256k1 ECDSA signature over the transaction,
 required when the grant's grantee is `Secp256k1`. `None` when the
 grantee is `Ed25519`, which authorises through `extra_signatories`
 instead.

cardano_account_custody_contract/types/A.title: AccountState
cardano_account_custody_contract/types/A.description:
The account's on-chain state: its owner devices, its outstanding grants,
 and a counter bumped whenever grants are replaced wholesale.

cardano_account_custody_contract/types/A.title: Asset
cardano_account_custody_contract/types/A.description:
An asset class: a policy id paired with an asset name. Lovelace is
 represented by the empty policy id and the empty asset name, mirroring
 `cardano/assets.ada_policy_id` and `cardano/assets.ada_asset_name`.

cardano_account_custody_contract/types/G.title: Grant
cardano_account_custody_contract/types/G.description:
A single revocable permission held by a grantee, identified by its slot
 in `AccountState.grants`.

cardano_account_custody_contract/types/G.title: Grantee
cardano_account_custody_contract/types/G.description:
A key that can authorise a grant, either Cardano's own Ed25519 keys or
 a Secp256k1 key: a 33 byte compressed secp256k1 public key, verified on
 chain with the secp256k1 ECDSA builtin, as used by custodial signing
 services.

cardano_account_custody_contract/types/M.title: MintRedeemer
cardano_account_custody_contract/types/M.description:
The redeemer for the account validator's mint handler, which creates or
 retires the account's state NFT.

cardano_account_custody_contract/types/S.title: Scope
cardano_account_custody_contract/types/S.description:
The bounds of a grant: which asset it covers, how much of it may leave
 the account per call and in total, how much lovelace may leave with it,
 when it stops being usable, and which destinations it allows.

fields.title: asset
fields.description: The asset class this scope's caps apply to.

fields.title: per_call_cap
fields.description:
The most of `asset` that may leave the account in a single
 transaction.

fields.title: cap
fields.description:
The most of `asset` that may leave the account over the grant's
 lifetime, reduced by what has already left.

fields.title: lovelace_cap
fields.description:
The most lovelace that may leave the account alongside `asset`,
 reduced by what has already left. Applies only when `asset` is not
 lovelace; must be zero when `asset` is lovelace, since the asset cap
 already covers lovelace in that case.

fields.title: expires_at
fields.description:
The POSIX time, in milliseconds, after which the grant can no longer
 be used. Must be greater than zero; there is no value that means the
 grant never expires.

fields.title: recipients
fields.description:
The addresses funds may be sent to. An empty list means any
 destination is allowed.
